audit_verdicts_index.headline: First physical-admissibility audit of the Brasher-Kingsbury (1954) coating water-uptake law against this module's single-frequency EIS substrate (USBR-21019, 306 records, 6 coating systems x 4 baths). H0 REFUTED on 6 of 6 independent physical screens. (T0) 6/306 records (1.96%) carry |phase| > 90 deg and are IMPOSSIBLE for any passive cell -- a previously undetected integrity defect localized to 1 source file(s). (T1) median dissipation factor 0.74: only 14.3% of records are capacitance-dominated, so no coating capacitance can be read at 0.01 Hz. (T2) log10 C_eff is Spearman -0.9921 with log10|Z| -- rank-redundant, zero new information. (T3) only 51.1% of derived water uptakes are physically plausible; 26.1% are negative and 3.0% exceed the film volume (max 3.83). (T4) only 1/36 series are monotone; the weak aggregate time drift (post-anchor rho +0.157, perm p=0.01065) is not system-robust (95% CI [-0.19, 0.50]), so no Fickian uptake trajectory is identified. (T5) panel-to-panel reproducibility propagates to sigma(phi_v)=0.67 volume fraction, 2.2x the entire 0-30 vol% physical range. Conclusion: the module's declared Kramers-Kronig / equivalent-circuit abstention is now quantitatively EVIDENCED, not merely asserted; |Z| remains the only defensible single-frequency descriptor.

audit_verdicts_index.headline: First within-EIS reproducibility & discrimination-power audit of USBR-21019 (6 systems x 4 baths, replicate + temporal structure previously unused): ISO-5725 endpoint reproducibility sigma_R=1.026 decades (late-window between-panel 0.836 + repeatability 0.594), pooled between-system barrier spread 0.982 decades (SNR 0.96, F=0.9). Against a parametric hostile null (all systems identical, noise only) the single-date EIS endpoint does NOT separate the six within-bath systems above its measurement-noise floor (p=0.2554); the 80%-power minimum detectable |Z| difference is 4.06 decades (1 panel) / 2.87 (2 panels). The dominant term is between-PANEL reproducibility, which time-averaging cannot reduce -- only more replicate panels can. The prior audits' '12-20 systems' target is recovered only under the strong aggregate effect (r~0.77 -> n=11); at the observed within-bath effect (r~0.30) n~90 systems are required. Verdict: EIS_WITHIN_INSTRUMENT_DISCRIMINATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

audit_verdicts_index.headline: Cross-instrument test on rights-clean USBR-21019 public data (6 coating systems x 4 baths, 24 paired cells): the pooled |Z|-vs-rustcreep Spearman is confounded and sign-reversed (rho=+0.32); after stratifying on exposure bath the published ISO-16773 low-frequency barrier metric recovers the physically-expected NEGATIVE association with independent scribe rust-creep (mean within-env rho=-0.30, 83% of cluster-bootstraps negative), but at n=6 systems it is underpowered (stratified-permutation p=0.096, 95% CI [-0.70, 0.50] crosses zero). Corroborates the module's model-readiness-only boundary; 20/24 endpoint cells sit in the ISO very-good barrier band (area-caveated).

audit_verdicts_index.headline: Multi-instrument concordance on rights-clean USBR-21019 (6 vinyl coating systems, 3 physically-independent corrosion instruments: EIS barrier, scribe rust-creep resistance, wet pull-off adhesion): Kendall's W=0.492 (Friedman chi2=7.38, df=5, chi2 p=0.194; exact-MC permutation p=0.202 over 200000 perms), mean pairwise Spearman=+0.238, leave-one-system-out W in [0.244, 0.689]. WEAK_OR_NULL_CONCORDANCE: the independent instruments positively co-order coating quality, but at n=6 the omnibus remains underpowered at 0.05 -- integrating a third instrument extends the prior single-pair test while confirming the module's model-readiness-only boundary.

honest_headline: Two independent evidence lines exist in this module. (1) BARE-SUBSTRATE, uncoated-metal seawater corrosion: NIST CORR-DATA LOSD-CV ridge MAE(log10 mm/yr)=0.6331 vs per-material-group-median NULL MAE=0.6806, a +0.0475 log10-unit (7.0%) reduction on n=588 records / 30 source documents -- modest but real, and the module's only externally-validated positive result (see evidence/phase0/kpis/nist-corr-data-marine-steel-corrosion-baseline-kpi.v1.json). (2) COATING-SIDE, USBR-21019 (6 coating systems x 4 baths, single-frequency 0.01 Hz EIS + rust-creep + wet pull-off adhesion): every audit attempted against this data has produced a negative, underpowered, or refuted result. Brasher-Kingsbury (1954) water-uptake reduction is H0_REFUTED on 6 of 6 independent physical screens (rank-redundant with |Z|, precondition-violating, range-inadmissible, no Fickian time signature, noise floor 2.2x the physical signal range). Within-instrument EIS discrimination among the 6 systems is NOT established at the observed effect size (p=0.2554; n~90 systems required at r~0.30, vs n~11 if the optimistic r~0.77 aggregate held). Cross-modality |Z|-vs-rustcreep concordance is sign-confounded when pooled and only recovers the physically-expected negative sign after bath-stratification, still underpowered at n=6 (CI crosses zero). Three-instrument concordance is WEAK_OR_NULL (Kendall's W=0.492, p=0.194-0.202). The module's correct, evidenced posture on coating-side claims is abstention, not because no test was tried, but because every test that was tried failed to clear its own pre-registered bar.
